name: Party Battles
hook: Pick your hero's move. Beat the waves, then the boss.
how: Your party of four (a knight, a mage, a cleric and a rogue) fights wave after wave of monsters. Every turn each player picks their hero's move: attack, a class skill, a potion or defend. Every fifth wave is a boss; see how far the party gets.
controls: Click or tap an action, then a target; keys 1 to 4 pick an action
uses: The most waves each player's party cleared.
The host's browser resolves every turn and plays the monsters; if it leaves, the next player takes over the same turn.
Bots play any hero nobody has picked, and take over for anyone who leaves.
Everyone sees each other's picks and the same turn play out.
ideas: Add a fifth hero, a bard who buffs the party
Let players spend gold on new skills between waves
Make the boss a giant robot with a laser attack
